branch_policy: Retain every parent-compatible branch. If exact parents do not select a unique branch, HI remains the complete lawful branch family.
claim_boundary: MINIMAL_SPINE RFC linear transfer realization: exact immutable branch-compatible HU-on-I instantiation, inherited mode/gauge/clock contracts and covariance propagation. No unique branch, new transfer coefficient, realized primordial spectrum, finite-volume field, observational transfer table, or empirical agreement.
compatibility_rule: A HI branch exists only when the same inherited G branch/source coordinates satisfy both frozen parent contracts, the HU perturbation lies in V_b=ker(C_b)/im(G_b), and the I background branch carries that same branch identity and inherited Big-Implosion clock family. No type coercion, branch shopping, or observed-data selection is allowed.

HU_covariance.law: For a fixed symbolic branch/operator realization, Sigma_out=U Sigma_in U^T. Operator uncertainty is retained as the branch-indexed family induced by inherited G covariance plus representation, numerical and unresolved-branch uncertainty; HU does not collapse that family by fitting a realized background.

parent_covariance.law: Sigma_G=J_G Sigma_F J_G^T + Sigma_process + Sigma_representation + Sigma_numeric + Sigma_branch with every added covariance term PSD

I_covariance.law: Sigma_I=J_I Sigma_G J_I^T + Sigma_incidence + Sigma_metric + Sigma_numeric + Sigma_branch, with every added term PSD. Unresolved incidence maps, G route amplitudes/spectral gaps/resolution widths and clock scale remain explicit branch coordinates.

parent.law: Sigma_G=J_G Sigma_F J_G^T + Sigma_process + Sigma_representation + Sigma_numeric + Sigma_branch with every added covariance term PSD

error_covariance_propagation.law: For perturbation covariance Sigma_delta on V_b, Sigma_delta,out = U_HU Sigma_delta,in U_HU^T. I background covariance Sigma_I remains attached unchanged. For any source-owned joint cross-covariance C_deltaI, the exact immutable product map gives C_out=U_HU C_deltaI and joint covariance [[U Sigma_delta U^T, U C],[C^T U^T, Sigma_I]]; HI neither sets unresolved cross-covariance to zero nor invents one.
error_covariance_propagation.unresolved_cross_covariance_policy: retain only if source-owned; do not invent and do not set to zero by assumption

HU_constraint_subspace.constraint: P_b^2=P_b and range(P_b) subset ker(C_b); therefore K_HU=P_b K_HU P_b maps the physical tangent subspace to itself. Gauge/representation-equivalent inputs are identified in the quotient and cannot become distinct physical outputs.
HU_constraint_subspace.frame_clock: HU inherits only the G clock family and branch labels from H_G_to_HU. Realized I geometry, scale factor, horizon, distance, metric, observed expansion history, or any background-specific numerical value is forbidden input.

gauge_frame_mapping.law: The HU quotient V_b=ker(C_b)/im(G_b), constraint projector and G clock contract remain unchanged. I contributes its realized finite-relational geometry and constant graph-gauge quotient as background context; HI does not identify or mix distinct gauge directions beyond exact shared ancestry.

instantiated_transfer_system.HU_domain: first-order tangent perturbations within each finite G branch for which the first variation exists, restricted to the exact constraint-preserving non-gauge quotient

HU_operator_family.codomain: same branch-indexed physical tangent quotient at the output G clock coordinate
HU_operator_family.domain: For each admitted G branch b, let X_G^b be the finite relational G state and T_b X_G its tangent space. Let C_b deltaX=0 denote the linearized exact G conservation/constraint ledger and let G_b denote pure representation/gauge directions. The physical linear domain is V_b=ker(C_b)/im(G_b); HU is the disjoint branch-indexed family V_HU=union_b {b}xV_b. No I geometry or realized expansion coordinate is part of V_HU.
HU_operator_family.generator: K_HU[b,eta] = P_b D L_G[rho_G^b(eta)] P_b, where L_G is the exact parent G generator/master-law, D is its first variation, and P_b is the exact finite projector/quotient representative onto the constraint-preserving non-gauge tangent space. Unresolved G branch coordinates remain symbolic arguments.
HU_operator_family.linearity_domain: first-order tangent perturbations within each finite G branch for which the first variation exists, restricted to the exact constraint-preserving non-gauge quotient
HU_operator_family.propagator: U_HU[b;eta2,eta1] is the unique finite time-ordered solution dU/deta=K_HU[b,eta] U with U(eta1,eta1)=I on each admitted finite branch; composition U(eta3,eta1)=U(eta3,eta2)U(eta2,eta1) and superposition follow on the declared linear domain.

I_background_context.nonuniqueness_policy: I freezes the complete lawful geometry branch family when exact ancestry does not uniquely select the process-to-edge incidence map; branch identity remains attached into HI/J
I_background_context.selection_rule: retain every nonobstructed mapping/route/clock branch satisfying the frozen constraint ledger; no observed expansion history, LambdaCDM parameter, standard distance ladder, or old P30 readiness proxy may select among them

instantiated_transfer_system.law: For each compatible branch b, HI_b := (I_b, U_HU[b;eta2,eta1]). Application to an admissible perturbation is deltaX_out = U_HU[b;eta2,eta1] deltaX_in while I_b is carried unchanged as realized background context. No background matrix, coefficient rescaling, or reparameterization is introduced unless already present in an exact parent.

mode_eigenstructure.generator_family: K_HU[b,eta] = P_b D L_G[rho_G^b(eta)] P_b, where L_G is the exact parent G generator/master-law, D is its first variation, and P_b is the exact finite projector/quotient representative onto the constraint-preserving non-gauge tangent space. mode_eigenstructure.law: The physical perturbation modes/eigenstructure are exactly those of the frozen HU generator/propagator on V_b, now indexed by the compatible frozen I branch. HI introduces no new eigenvalue or mode selection.
mode_eigenstructure.propagator_family: U_HU[b;eta2,eta1] is the unique finite time-ordered solution dU/deta=K_HU[b,eta] U with U(eta1,eta1)=I on each admitted finite branch; composition U(eta3,eta1)=U(eta3,eta2)U(eta2,eta1) and superposition follow on the declared linear domain.
